summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist, exported it explicitly from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection after Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Per instructions, no tests or code were run and nothing was committed; I only confirmed no new line exceeds 120 columns. Choices: non-list values under the data list key raise ValueError, and non-string "test" entries fail the image check.
